items.name: USNI News Western Pacific Pulse: Sept. 11, 2026
items.summary: The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week.  In the South China Sea Aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72), cruiser USS Robert Smalls (CG-62), destroyer USS Frank E. Petersen Jr. (DDG-121) are operating in the South China Sea following their departure from Thailand on Sunday after completing a port visit. At Lumut Naval Base, Malaysia Indian Navy destroyer INS Mysore (D60) arrived Wednesday at Royal Malaysian Navy Lumut Naval Base to join RMN corvette KD Lekir (FSG26) and training ship KD Gagah Samudera (271) for exercise Samudra Laksamana 4/26.
